organCounts:
PREFIX fb: <http://phenomebrowser.net/flopo/browse#>
SELECT ?og (COUNT(DISTINCT ?t) AS ?n) WHERE { ?r a fb:TraitRecord ; fb:organGroup ?og ; fb:taxon ?t } GROUP BY ?og
valueChoices:
PREFIX fb: <http://phenomebrowser.net/flopo/browse#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?og ?q (SAMPLE(?ql) AS ?label) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?t) AS ?n) WHERE {
  ?r a fb:TraitRecord ; fb:organGroup ?og ; fb:quality ?q ; fb:taxon ?t ; fb:negated false . ?q rdfs:label ?ql
  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?r fb:low ?x } } GROUP BY ?og ?q HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?t) > 1) ORDER BY ?label
